data_description.custom_datasheet_json:
Optional spec for your heat pump. Leave empty to use the Basic profile defaults.

**Minimum required fields:** `family` (str), `kw` (float), `lwt_min` (float), `lwt_max` (float), `nom_cop` (float).

**Optional fields:** `bivalent` (bool), `buh_kw` (float), `refrigerant` (R32 / R290 / R410A), `min_modulation_kw` (float), `max_flow_lmin` (float), `noise_db` (float).

**Optional COP curve points:** list of objects with keys `label`, `t_out`, `t_lwc`, `cop`.

**Minimal example:**

    {spec_example_min}

**Example with COP curve:**

    {spec_example_full}

model_custom_info.description:
Your heat pump is not one of the bundled Daikin models.

A custom selection inherits the **Basic profile** defaults (safe fallback). You can tune detection thresholds, comfort bounds, and COP analysis later in the integration Options menu.

The next page maps your ESPAltherma attribute names to the integration's canonical keys.
model_custom_info.title: Custom heat pump

notifications.title: Notifications

data_description.dhw_pendulum_cycles_per_hour: DHW cycles per hour that trigger a DHW pendulum alert. Default 3.
data_description.pendulum_cycles_per_day: Daily cycle count that triggers a pendulum alert. Default 35-40. Lower = more alerts.
data_description.short_off_threshold_min: Off-times shorter than this are 'short offs'. Default 5 min. Lower = stricter.
data_description.short_run_threshold_min: Cycles shorter than this are 'short runs'. Default 20 min. Lower = stricter.

pendulum.description:
Values below mark a cycle as 'short' (pendelen). Lower = stricter, more alerts.

- **Short run** (default 20 min): cycles shorter than this are flagged.
- **Short off** (default 5 min): off-times shorter than this are flagged.
- **Pendulum cycles/day** (default 35-40): daily count that triggers an alert.
- **DHW cycles/hour** (default 3): DHW-specific pendulum trigger.
pendulum.title: Pendulum thresholds

data_description.good_dt_threshold_k: Minimum dT (K) for full marks. Default 5.0 K. Below = -20 points.
data_description.good_off_threshold_min: Minimum off-time for full marks. Default 20 min. Below = -20 points.
data_description.good_run_threshold_min: Runtime at or above this scores full marks. Default 45 min. Below = -30 points.
data_description.target_cycles_per_day: Target cycles per day for efficient operation. Default 8. Used for ratio-based advice.

quality.description:
Thresholds used to score a cycle 0-100. Meeting a threshold avoids a penalty.

- **Good run** (default 45 min): runtime ≥ this scores full marks. Below: −30 points.
- **Good dT** (default 5.0 K): minimum dT for full marks. Below: −20 points.
- **Good off** (default 20 min): minimum off-time for full marks. Below: −20 points.
- **Target cycles/day** (default 8): efficiency target, used in ratio-based advice.
quality.title: Quality thresholds
